name: Agent work queue
blurb: A dependency-aware issue queue for coding agents, in the style of beads: file work, link what waits on what, claim what is ready, close it.
about: A work queue for coding agents, where each agent asks what is ready, claims it so no other agent can, and closes it when done. Issues, what waits on what, parent and child work, comments and project memories are linked, and readiness is worked out from those links on every read. Agents file and re-plan work, and a person reviews the plans they put on a branch.

questions.q: What can an agent claim now?
